checks.detail: The README states twice (live_readme.md lines 213 and 566) that 'the library exposes 243 public types in total' and backs this with a table of exactly 243 rows. Independently fetched `src/aspose_html/dom/__init__.py` fresh via `gh api repos/aspose-html-foss/Aspose.HTML-FOSS-for-Python/contents/src/aspose_html/dom/__init__.py?ref=bf0f1e7a6d29ca9e14de576fe3ff1aa49ddbaf11` (pinned source_revision, no drift) and read its `__all__` list (337 names) directly. The API Reference table's DOM section (live_readme.md) includes two rows -- `BrowsingContext` (line 283) and `WindowEventLoop` (line 446) -- that are each described, in the table's own prose, as 'Internal' ('Internal owner of navigation lifecycle/document state' and 'Internal task-source scheduler used by Window/BrowsingContext' respectively). Neither name appears anywhere in `dom/__init__.py`'s `__all__`, confirming they are not part of the package's documented public import surface (`from aspose_html.dom import BrowsingContext` would raise ImportError). The README's own table text ('Internal') directly contradicts its own headline and total-count claim that every listed row is one of '243 public types'.

lane_r_plan.md's case-A convergence reasoning ('no contradiction found, live README already satisfies the fixed-core contract, converge to it unchanged') is undermined by C3: a real, checkable contradiction exists in the very claim ('243 public types') that functions as the API Reference section's own factual anchor. The fixed-core structural elements (badge row, banner, Navigation, At a Glance, standard section names) are indeed all present, but structural conformance does not make the content accurate, and Lane R's candidate inherits the same false count by converging unchanged.

findings.detail: The README asserts twice, as unqualified fact, that the library exposes 243 public types, and backs this with a table of 243 class rows. Independent verification against the live source at the pinned revision (bf0f1e7a6d29ca9e14de576fe3ff1aa49ddbaf11) shows the DOM section of that table includes at least 2 classes (BrowsingContext, WindowEventLoop) that are not part of the public API: they are defined in underscore-prefixed private modules and are not imported or re-exported by aspose_html/dom/__init__.py's __all__, so they are not reachable via the package's documented import surface -- and are themselves described in the very same table as 'Internal'. This makes the '243 public types' claim false as stated (true publicly-importable count from the DOM module alone is at most 241 by this one check, and only the DOM section of a 10-section table was audited, so the true total discrepancy across the full table is not yet bounded). This error was never caught in the original pass because facts.json explicitly scoped the API Reference table out of this pass's verification (see C2), and both lane_l_candidate.md and lane_r_candidate.md inherit it unchanged from live_readme.md.

facts.json's 3-fact / 4-claim coverage is thin relative to this README's size and claim density. A systematic pass over the full API Reference table (all 10 sections, not just DOM) and the 7-item Key Capabilities list is still outstanding and should be completed before any revised candidate is re-submitted, since F-243-PUBLIC-TYPES-CLAIM-FALSE shows the untouched sections are not safe to assume correct by extension.

verdict_rationale: The REJECT-worthy defect (F-243-PUBLIC-TYPES-CLAIM-FALSE) has been independently re-verified and fixed. Re-verification session 2026-10-21 fetched src/aspose_html/dom/__init__.py fresh at the pinned revision (bf0f1e7a6d29ca9e14de576fe3ff1aa49ddbaf11) via both the GitHub Contents API and raw.githubusercontent.com (byte-identical, sha 4bba7274fa40360fe3d94dc8ecaa2aee6a1a4100) and parsed its __all__ directly: 171 names (170 classes/exceptions + 1 function), confirming BrowsingContext and WindowEventLoop are genuinely not part of the public import surface, matching their own 'Internal' table labels. (Note: this re-verification also found the original finding's cited figure of '337 names' in dom/__init__.py's __all__ does not hold up -- 337 is that file's line count, not its parsed __all__ entry count, which is 171; this does not change the finding's conclusion, since BrowsingContext/WindowEventLoop are absent from __all__ either way.) lane_l_candidate.md (and lane_r_candidate.md, which was byte-identical) has been corrected: the two non-exported, self-labeled-Internal rows (BrowsingContext, WindowEventLoop) were removed from the DOM section of the API Reference table, and both headline mentions of the count were corrected from 243 to 241 (243 - 2), matching the table's now-actual row count. The fix is captured in lane_l_candidate.diff, scoped to exactly these 4 changes, and recorded in facts.json as F-243-PUBLIC-TYPES-CLAIM-CONTRADICTED. Verdict updated from REJECT to ACCEPT after the fix; this is not a retroactive downgrade of the finding -- the finding stands as correctly identified and is marked 'fixed', not erased, per this project's AGENTS.md re-reporting discipline. F-FACTS-COVERAGE-THIN (MODERATE) remains open and unresolved: only the DOM section's export list was independently re-parsed this pass; the other 9 API Reference sections' row counts were not cross-checked against their respective modules' __all__ lists, and a preliminary look at the CSS section suggests a similar overcount may exist there (its 16 table rows appear to be internal AST classes not re-exported by aspose_html/css/__init__.py's 2-function __all__) -- a systematic full-table audit is still outstanding and was intentionally kept out of this pass's scope, which was bounded to the specific REJECT finding already raised.
